prompts.prompt: Provide a thorough nuanced analysis of [TOPIC]. Consider: multiple perspectives, potential biases, empirical evidence, counterarguments, ethical considerations, practical implications.
Edit and improve this text: [TEXT]. Focus on: clarity, flow, grammar, word choice, structure, tone. Provide: edited version, explanation of changes, further suggestions.
Research everything known about [TOPIC]. Structure: overview, history, current knowledge, debates, applications, future outlook. Be accurate and thorough.
Explain this code to a beginner: [CODE]. Include: what it does, how it works step by step, why each part exists, common use cases, potential improvements.
Brainstorm creative ideas for [TOPIC]. Generate 10 unique ideas ranging from conventional to wildly creative. For each: description, why it could work, potential challenges.
